A group of feral [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] had set up a camp on a high-rising rock formation that was accessible via large branches of the high-rising trees of the [[Rryatt Trail#Webweaver Path|Webweaver Path]] level of the [[Rryatt Trail]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It consisted of several primitive huts.

==Behind the scenes==
The Feral Wookiee camp appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
